[{"name":"season_yoy_growth","idea":"Seasonal signal: the item's audience growth in the same period one cycle (365 steps) earlier, measured as distinct users in [A-365, A-335) over distinct users in [A-395, A-365), so the model can anticipate recurring demand in the label window.","level":"item","sql":"SELECT item_id, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t >= {A} - 365 THEN user_id END) + 1 AS DOUBLE) / (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t < {A} - 365 THEN user_id END) + 1) AS ag_season_yoy FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 395 AND t < {A} - 335 GROUP BY item_id;"},
{"name":"adoption_rate_eligible","idea":"Penetration-adjusted demand: the item's distinct users in the last 30 steps divided by the active users of the last 30 steps who had not already taken the item before A-30, because a pair can occur only once and saturated items have less remaining potential.","level":"item","sql":"WITH au AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30), na AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM au), it AS (SELECT e.item_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.t >= {A} - 30 THEN e.user_id END) AS r, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.t < {A} - 30 AND au.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN e.user_id END) AS o FROM ev e LEFT JOIN au ON au.user_id = e.user_id GROUP BY e.item_id) SELECT it.item_id, CAST(it.r AS DOUBLE) / GREATEST(na.n - it.o, 1) AS ag_adopt_rate FROM it CROSS JOIN na;"},
{"name":"item_age_gap","idea":"Taste for fresh versus established items: the absolute difference between ln(1 + current age of candidate j) and the user's mean ln(1 + age of the item at interaction time) over their last 20 items.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH fi AS (SELECT item_id, MIN(t) AS f FROM ev GROUP BY item_id), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, t FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, t, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 20), ua AS (SELECT lu.user_id, AVG(LN(1 + lu.t - fi.f)) AS m FROM lu JOIN fi ON fi.item_id = lu.item_id GROUP BY lu.user_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, ABS(LN(1 + {A} - fi.f) - ua.m) AS ag_age_gap FROM cand c JOIN ua ON ua.user_id = c.user_id JOIN fi ON fi.item_id = c.item_id;"},
{"name":"session_cooc","idea":"Tight-session similarity: cosine co-occurrence over the last 90 steps that counts only item pairs taken by the same user within 1 step of each other, summed over the user's 5 most recent items.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH e AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, t FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 90), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 5), src AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM lu), ni AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e GROUP BY item_id), co AS (SELECT a.item_id AS i, b.item_id AS j, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e a JOIN e b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.item_id <> b.item_id AND b.t >= a.t - 1 AND b.t <= a.t + 1 WHERE a.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(co.c / sqrt(n1.c * n2.c)) AS ag_sess_cooc FROM cand c JOIN lu ON lu.user_id = c.user_id JOIN co ON co.i = lu.item_id AND co.j = c.item_id JOIN ni n1 ON n1.item_id = co.i JOIN ni n2 ON n2.item_id = co.j GROUP BY 1, 2;"},
{"name":"pop_gap","idea":"Signed popularity match: ln(1 + recent-30 audience of candidate j) minus the user's mean of the same quantity over their last 20 items, giving trees a direct measure of how far the candidate lies from the user's mainstream level.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH ip AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30 GROUP BY item_id), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 20), up AS (SELECT lu.user_id, AVG(LN(1 + COALESCE(ip.c, 0))) AS m FROM lu LEFT JOIN ip ON ip.item_id = lu.item_id GROUP BY lu.user_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, LN(1 + COALESCE(ip.c, 0)) - up.m AS ag_pop_gap FROM cand c JOIN up ON up.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN ip ON ip.item_id = c.item_id;"}]
